verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gate overrides that let specific users bypass a gate and force specific users into a variant for testing or QA. It also supports targeting by username, email, or other identifiers, and its tutorial targets internal testers, so per-user inclusion (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts) is clearly covered. Explicit per-user exclusion (blocklisting individual users from a gate) is not documented in the evidence. missing for 10: documented per-user exclusion/blocklist overrides, depth on managing override lists (size limits, ID types, bulk upload), independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)
